does: Executes a DealDamage functor at a position rather than on a target (the server's StatsFunctorDealDamage::Execute overload with a position and a radius): when the position is on the level's grid it rolls the functor's damage again, lets fire (damage type 7) and lightning (8) act on surfaces at the position in a 2.4 m radius and passes the damage on, for what lies there, to a function the registry does not name.
